text: Election of the Chair of the Board of Health under Part H, Section 22 of the Board of Health Procedures By-law, as amended, for a term of office starting January 20, 2025 and ending December 31, 2025, and until a successor is appointed.
The Board of Health: 1. Elected Director Chris Moise as Chair of the Board of Health for a term of office starting January 20, 2025 and ending December 31, 2025 and until a successor is appointed.
